verdict.rationale: Semgrep Secrets and the core CLI are documented explicitly as scanning code/repositories/folders (e.g. semgrep-docs-8, semgrep-docs-19, semgrep-docs-27), with no mention of scanning non-git sources such as S3 buckets, Docker images, or CI logs. This is a fair capability to ask of a secret-detection tool, but no evidence in the pack shows Semgrep supporting these source types.
